$comment: The one names map: every Hatsu skill and agent with its code name (as the repository spells it), a plain alias and a one-line description. Aliases marked aliasSource 'D4' come from the Naming section D4 of the Craft build-prompt document (2026-11-04); 'derived' aliases are the site's plain-English reading of the hatsu README's Meaning column and are flagged for review. Code names stay as the OSS spells them (Sergio's call); the shibari → musubi rename is PROPOSED only. A build-time test fails when a skill or agent in the hatsu repository is missing here. Descriptions are the site's own one-liners; the repository's frontmatter is rendered beside them on the docs pages.

kurapika.description: The lead persona and the whole local plane in one identity; names one of six work-modes before acting.

nobunaga.description: Code practices, scope completeness and adversarial reading; the default reviewer on every change.

hisoka.description: UI/UX review and cheap objective measurement before a PR, citing the UX baseline by rule id.

feitan.description: Security review only: deterministic scans first, then the security baseline by rule id.

chrollo.description: Architecture and handbook conformance against the one stack handbook that governs the repository.

uvogin.description: Performance on seven fixed metrics, each number with its method and baseline.

phinks.description: Adversarial pre-release QA: files only a test failing three times or a measured number.

leorio.description: Economics review, only when a change may move money; a charted report for and against.

illumi.description: The long read-only watch while a PR waits for readiness; wakes the lead, never acts.

shalnark.description: Post-merge UI validation: ephemeral automated tests against the delivered acceptance criteria.

netero.description: Chairman of process: files complete issues when canon or machinery need enhancement.

shizuku.description: Cleanup only: inventories what an effort left behind and removes only what you picked.

gon.description: The mission-scoped trusted delegate; his delegation grammar is a draft, so he crosses no gate.

satotz.description: Challenges a product brief's problem, audience, success criteria and scope at intake.

lippo.description: Challenges a brief's edge cases and conflicts with the specification in force.

buhara.description: Challenges each platform's constraints and the parity a brief promises across them.

bisky.description: Drafts a brief's Design Direction, then challenges its rendered parts.

ten.description: Verify and bind the pinned Nen on the host and place this surface's copy; the first step of every session.

bakuryuha.description: Bring this surface's Hatsu to the newest version its channel offers and switch onto it.

ren.description: One request, one turn, in an isolated effort worktree; never pushes.

breath.description: Once per effort: fetch, fast-forward the base, cut the branch, prove the checks on the fresh tip.

rasengan.description: Author the change and its focused tests inside the request's scope; commits nothing.

kokusen.description: Verify the finished tree, then commit locally with a formatted message.

gyo.description: Lint, the declared lint verb; never tests, never coverage.

tsukuyomi.description: The focused tests for the behaviour this turn changed; never the full suite.

amaterasu.description: Build and launch the declared target from your core checkout and hand back the command.

spiritual-message.description: The rich turn or landing report: what landed, what did not, evidence and spend.

jutaisho.description: Ring the bell at the end of a turn and ask the gate question through your surface's picker.

ao.description: Pull from the base: rebase if unpushed, merge if published; a semantic conflict stops.

aka.description: Push, yours to call: lint, squash the unpushed commits, catch up, push.

mukai.description: The whole PR side in order: review, tests, coverage, evidence, one PR, then the offer of en.
mukai.gate: human-called phase; ends at the merge prompt through en

murasaki.description: Bring a published branch up to date with its base and rerun the checks before any push.

hanten.description: Adversarial review before the PR: one reviewer per raised scope, every finding settled.

kotoamatsukami.description: The project-wide unit, UI and integration suites the change can affect.

byakugan.description: Coverage capture and touched-file measurement against the declared ladder.

shibari.description: Compose the PR body from the section catalogue, check it, open one PR and request reviewers.

en.description: One PR from open to verified Ready and your merge prompt, under an acting-cycle cap.

sharingan.description: Drive one PR to readiness at its gate and stop there; never merges, never votes.

pr-state.description: One PR's readiness as the deterministic verdict, quoted conjunct by conjunct. Read-only.

third-hand.description: The sitting's process friction harvested into up to three issues you pick.

cleanup.description: What a finished effort left behind, inventoried and removed only as you picked.

amenotejikara.description: Swap which worktree your core checkout holds, and swap back; never discards.

jujutsu.description: Pair a device and register it as a launch target through a PR.

emperor-time.description: Product intake: one raw idea interviewed into a decision-complete brief, challenged, filed on your confirmation.

file.description: One well-formed, correctly labelled, non-duplicate issue.

classify.description: The two label axes, language and job, on an issue, a set, a backlog or an inline effort.

direct.description: Which model should do the work and where: three picks on five axes, read live.

build.description: One issue to a delivery PR standing at its human gate.

futon.description: One selector of the backlog to PRs, then the typed next step once every PR is merged.
futon.gate: G2 per PR; the then step on your advance go

kazaana.description: Everything this surface's model can build, delivered in parallel, then the release tag.
kazaana.gate: G2 per PR; G3 asked once after the tag

kage-bunshin.description: A hand-picked list of issues, each to a PR at its gate, in order or in parallel.

kamui.description: One issue or shipped PR written as the product family's spec, then port issues per sibling you pick.

dowsing-chain.description: A product family's repositories read into one living spec, landed in waves.

hiraishin.description: One merged PR ported to one sibling repository, spec first, built to the target's merge prompt.
hiraishin.gate: G1 on the typed call; G2 on the port

backlog-loop.description: The backlog to zero in severity order, with release tags at batch boundaries.

backlog-synthesis.description: A long backlog reconciled into a short one, behind a plan you approve.

backlog-state.description: The backlog as one gate-oriented table. Read-only.

backlog-board.description: The same sweep as a rendered board page. Read-only.

rikugan.description: The final state of a just-completed workflow as one page. Read-only.

senkei.description: A consumer repository's own efforts inventoried and classified, stuck PRs handed on.

black-voice.description: Post-merge UI validation, on your call only.

izanagi.description: Repeat an acting task until a condition holds, under a mandatory cap.

izanami.description: Repeat a read-only task until a condition holds.

tensho.description: A dirty working copy into one PR standing at its gate.

jujisho.description: A mixed working copy split into two stacked PRs by axis.

susanoo.description: The distributable the lane declares, built locally; uploads nothing.

getsuga.description: The release tag end to end, with its own release-proposal PR.
getsuga.gate: human-called phase; the tag, never publication

kagutsuchi.description: A build to a declared non-production destination, behind a freshness gate.

mugetsu.description: Publish one release to one production destination, on your own go only.

tenkai.description: Make a repository a working consumer, deterministically; diagnoses before it writes.

okiro.description: Stand up a new Hatsu-first project in an empty directory from one confirmed plan.

limbo.description: A consumer's canon mirror kept current on every declared surface.

jusshin.description: A consumer's self-hosted runners raised and proven by a preflight job.

kuchiyose.description: A CI reviewers tier installed on an adopted consumer as one PR; Apps and secrets stay yours.

great-hiker.description: Canon prose and machinery authored once and landed on every surface.

bankai-handbooks.description: Which handbooks and rule-id prefixes govern a repository, read from the pinned canon.

bankai-quality.description: Which QA and performance tooling a repository's scenario uses.

bankai-rule.description: One port ruling recorded as a row in the handbooks' ports file, one PR per run.

$plainWordSkills: Code names that are also ordinary English words; the commercial-page check skips them because they occur in plain prose (and 'en' is the html lang attribute).
